judgments.reason: The supplied transcript and model reasoning do not claim or show bids exceeding available coins due to the commission being applied before payment; the rules state the winner pays the bid and then receives the three-coin commission, and no mechanism allowing overbidding is articulated or demonstrated.

judgments.quote: Wait to observe opponent bids on lot 1. This preserves my options and gives me tactical information for planning my approach to the decisive final lot.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly uses waiting to learn revealed committed rival bids (clerk reveals committed bids in the transcript) and plans bids based on those observations, correctly identifying that waiting yields information about opponents' committed bids before you commit.

The rules and transcript state that close settles after all three lots are sold; the model closes only after all lots are allocated. There is no demonstration or articulation that close can settle with unauctioned lots remaining.

Catalog purchases are described as not being auction wins and the model never claims that the three-coin auction commission applies to catalog buys; no mechanism showing commission applied to catalog purchases is articulated or demonstrated.
